answer: Sybil crews flood attestation with cheap aliases. An applicant hangs a 3.1 kg rotary meter at mapped inlet IN-84, pairs it with lagoon buoy L-22 1.6 km out, and caches a 9,600-token bond in a tundra lockbox at cairn TN-17. Verifiers open 5 of 12 sealed hourly tapes at random: inlet discharge must stay within 0.12 m3/s of the lagoon gauge, and the tundra box must drop 5.4 C +/- 0.3 overnight versus the official transect. A miss cuts 42% of that bond and bars the name for 8 epochs. Eighty aliases lock 768,000 tokens and risk 322,560 on the first bad tape; a farm cannot hide behind one wallet.
